unit.why: A single anecdote: after the Seer of Lublin's death his disciples gather in Komarno, R. Zvi Hirsh of Zhidachov recounts his own spiritual levels, and R. Naftali of Ropshitz later explains to the Apter Rav that this showed humility.

stories.start_quote: ידוע כי אחרי פטירת מרן מלובלין
stories.summary_en: After the Seer of Lublin died, his disciples met in Komarno to choose a new rebbe. R. Zvi Hirsh recounted his own spiritual levels for two hours. Asked about this boasting by the Apter Rav, R. Naftali of Ropshitz said he had never seen such humility and had never heard such an Amidah since R. Elimelekh.
